name: read_resource
description: Read a local file, list a directory, or view an image.

location.description: Absolute host path, local file URI, HTTP(S) URL, or result.uri from an earlier read. Omit to list the startup directory.

view.description: To open media identified by a preview, use result.view.

anyOf.description: Preview a page. Offsets and sizes count UTF-8 bytes in text or entries in a directory.

limit.description: Requested page size. Omit to let the reader choose.

metadata.description: Include modification times and regular-file sizes in directory listings when available.

anyOf.description: The image view sends local image content or an image URL to the model service. A local file can hold the URL. The file view attaches a whole local file for parsing.
